Small off-grid kits (100–400W)

# Solar Panel Kits — Buying Guide

Solar panel kits bundle the components needed to generate electricity from sunlight. The right kit depends on whether you're powering a home, RV, cabin, or portable devices.

## Types of solar panel kits

<box gap={3}>
  <row align=start gap={3}>
    <AsyncImage query="100 watt solar panel kit charge controller cables RV off grid product" aspectRatio="5:4" maxWidth="144px" shop_eligible={true}/>
    <box flex="1" gap={1}>
      **Small off-grid kits (100–400W)**

      Great for RVs, camping, sheds, and charging small batteries. Usually include panels, mounting hardware, and a charge controller.
    </box>
  </row>
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <row align=start gap={3}>

    <box flex="1" gap={1}>
      **Medium off-grid kits (400–1,200W)**

      Suitable for cabins, larger RVs, and small backup-power systems. Often paired with a battery and inverter.
    </box>
  </row>
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <row align=start gap={3}>
    <AsyncImage query="residential rooftop solar panel kit inverter black solar panels house roof" aspectRatio="5:4" maxWidth="144px" shop_eligible={true}/>
    <box flex="1" gap={1}>
      **Home solar kits (3–10kW+)**

      Designed to offset household electricity usage. Require appropriate inverters, electrical protection, and typically permits and utility approval.
    </box>
  </row>
</box>
